note: Visible tests parse plain sections and keys; hidden tests cover comments that are only comments at the start of a line, continuation lines, duplicates, the global section and errors that name the line.

twin_breaks.rule: `;` and `#` start a comment only at the start of a line
A line that starts with a space or a tab, and is not blank or a comment, continues the value of the key before it
Errors raise `ValueError` whose message contains `line N`
